name: Read-time-honest sentiment velocity — blended social sentiment cross, spam-guarded (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: same read-time-honest thesis at a slightly slower, cheaper cadence — a bullish swing in the blended social_sentiment precedes the move as fresh narrative converts to flow, but 4h halves the fee drag versus 1h while still front-running dashboard-lagged retail. The blended sentiment is only PIT-honest where its components are read-time; the 4h bar gives more sampling headroom, reducing stale-repeat risk. Crucially, gate on spam (a low spam reading) so a coordinated bot burst does not masquerade as genuine narrative. Counterparty is thread-reading discretionary traders. DISCONFIRMER: if the effect is symmetric in lead-lag (equal at -1 and +1) the sentiment is coincident, not predictive, KILL. If dropping the spam gate does not degrade OOS Sharpe the spam screen is inert (fine) but a spike with high spam and no breadth must be excluded. Must clear 4h round-trip fees.
catalyst: a bullish blended-sentiment swing that is not spam-driven
